verify.scope: Exact Source and LINEAGE bytes, portable model and implementation relations, exact historical ZIP bindings, schema definitions, SYSTEM formal rule/vector evaluation, or exported byte bindings.
verify.execution: Only the selected local commit's SYSTEM evaluator; no canonical STATE verifier or archive execution. The report binds the evaluator bytes.
verify.missing_checker: INCOMPLETE, never PASSED; legacy revisions may request an explicit preview

export.input: One full locally available Git commit ID and a fresh destination.
export.incomplete_preview: Only by explicit --allow-incomplete; failure of an available checker still blocks export.

recover.input: One explicit revision or an export with an independently trusted manifest SHA-256.
recover.output: Byte-identical portable edition in a fresh destination, followed by integrity verification.

publication.revision: Resolved only from an explicit full commit ID, never from ORIGIN.repository.inspected_commit.
publication.index: Generated inventory and bounded operation contracts, not a hand-maintained second core.
publication.manifest: Exact SHA-256 and byte_length for every exported file except the manifest itself.
publication.carriers: application/zip; exact outer bytes checked against derivation and implementation bindings, ZIP recognition only; no extraction, nested-member reinspection, execution or authenticity claim.
publication.trust: A manifest digest needs an independent trusted channel; internal consistency is not authentication.

unestablished: Present capability or constitutional conformance from formal representation checks
effect_ceiling: Derivative maintenance and byte correspondence only; no independent Source, constitutional effect, or demonstrated CSC/DCR.
